shortTitle: Hypertension Concordance in Sexual Minority Couples in Annals of Epidemiology
longTitle: Within-partner concordance of hypertension and overweight/obesity among sexual minority couples
summary: Sam Opara led the writing of this manuscript on same-sex couples and their concordant cardiovascular health outcomes. This study highlighted a major gap in the literature regarding the unavailability of reliable data on sexual minority couples in the United States.
citation: Opara S., Moran C.A. et.al. Within-partner concordance of hypertension and overweight/obesity among sexual minority couples. Annals of Epidemiology. 2025. 107:8-12. doi:10.1016/j.annepidem.2025.05.004
